contrast.note: From pixels: ground = modal colour of the indicator row; mark = first ink cluster from the left (the dot; BEFORE stale has no mark, so its 'mark' is the label's first glyph; BEFORE older's is the 18px spinner ring); label = most extreme ink right of the mark. markRatioRange spans the still plus every pre-release sequence frame: only ~300 ms of the 2 s pulse, so it is a PARTIAL phase range. The full-cycle trough/peak is `pulseCycle` below.

pulseCycle.note: Cold case held >=2.6 s (more than one 2 s pulse cycle), capturePage() in a loop (~35-44 ms gap). Dot = centre pixel (396,104), ground = (300,104), WCAG 2.x. domOpacity = computed opacity of [data-lo-loading-dot] on every rAF. r0 = 79f3126b4 build (the head the 8b4355d43 frames describe; 8b4355d43 adds only docs), r1 = 7887d0bf0.
